description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance of three different language models under four distinct training conditions. The horizontal axis contains the model categories, ordered from left to right by increasing parameter size: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. The vertical axis represents the performance value, labeled "CoLeG-R (%)", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 80 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. For each model category, there is a group of four bars representing the training conditions, which are identified by a legend in the bottom right corner and distinguished by color and white hatched patterns. The light blue bar with diagonal hatching represents "no SFT", the light orange bar with horizontal hatching represents "+ SFT on $D_0$", the light purple bar with diagonal hatching represents "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$", and the light pink bar with diagonal hatching represents "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$". In the LLaMA-2-7B group, values range from approximately 66% for both "no SFT" and "+ SFT on $D_0$"—which are the shortest bars in the chart—to about 84% for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$". In the LLaMA-2-13B group, values start at roughly 70% for "no SFT" and peak at approximately 85% for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$", which is the tallest bar in the chart. For the LLaMA-2-70B group, the bars show values of approximately 81% for "no SFT", 82% for "+ SFT on $D_0$", 84% for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$", and 83% for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$". The chart features a subtle speckled background texture, and all bars are visually emphasized with their respective hatched overlays.
